failed_conditions.quote: However, what we do next is suspicious.  In line 120, we call `publisher->toggle()`, which is the first time that we are instantiating the underlying `rclcpp::Publisher`.  And then we are immediately calling `publisher->get_publishers_info_by_topic()`, which doesn't wait around at all; it just returns what it has right now.  So we have not given discovery any time to happen, and update the graph cache (which is what we are looking at here).

resolution.quote: So with all of that said, I think the fix here is to have the test attempt to `get_publishers_info_by_topic` a few times before giving up.  That will give discovery time to happen in almost all cases.

notes: Verified via gh api: issue #440 body (the CI stacktrace from ci_linux 18164 with publishers_info.size() == 0 where 1u was expected, and the reporter's data_readers_/data_writers_ race analysis linking rmw_node.cpp at 4bec4c8c) and clalancette's comment-1490563629 quoted above. Eligible PAIR at step 6 (library API): the test assumes the graph query reflects a publisher created one line earlier; rmw_cyclonedds_cpp updates its graph cache asynchronously from its discovery thread, and with a middleware that answers synchronously the assertion holds, so the failure depends on an assumption between the two units. Class 'other' is right (a consistency/timing assumption on rmw_get_publishers_info_by_topic; no listed class names it). Silent: the middleware returned an empty list with no diagnostic; only the test's own assertion caught it. Resolution 'recommended' agreed: the retry fix (PR #513) and the rmw.h contract note (rmw PR #352) were merged, but the source does not show the resolved composition working with both units identified by revision.
